examples.arabic: شفت بياع خضرة وحكيت له صباح الخير
examples.english: I saw a vegetable seller and said to him, 'Good morning.'
examples.transliteration: Shoft bayya' khodra w hakeit-lo sabah el-kheir.
examples.storyTitle: A Trip to the Local Market

examples.english: I saw many people and a vegetable vendor.
examples.transliteration: Sheft nās ktīr u bayyāʿ khoḍra.

examples.arabic: بالطريق شفت بياع خضرة عم يبيع بالسوق
examples.english: On the way, I saw a vegetable vendor selling in the market.
examples.transliteration: baṭ-ṭareeq shoft bayya' khoḍra 'am ybee' bes-souq

examples.arabic: شفنا ناس كتير وبياع الخضرة كان عم يضحك
examples.english: We saw many people and the vegetable vendor was laughing.
examples.transliteration: Shefna nās ktīr w bayyāʿ el-khoḍra kān ʿam yeḍḥak.

examples.english: I saw the apple and vegetable vendor there.
